title: Trip Log — Nautical Miles and Time Underway
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading measurement=navigation
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(distance_nm) as nm, sum(eval(if(underway="true",duration_min,0)))/60 as hours by _time
| sort - _time
description: Logs nautical miles covered and hours underway each day, building the cruising record every skipper keeps.
value: A digital trip log captures the miles and hours automatically, feeding logbooks, insurance, and sea-time claims.
implementation: Ingest navigation data into `index=personal`; total distance and time underway daily.
visualization: Column chart of daily nautical miles with hours underway.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how far you sailed and how long you were out each day, the record every skipper keeps.
